content: ML /item/{id}/performance endpoint: returns entity_type, entity_id, score (0-100), level (e.g. 'Good'), level_wording (e.g. 'Profesional'), calculated_at, buckets[]. Each bucket: key (e.g. CHARACTERISTICS, OFFER), status (PENDING/COMPLETED), score, title, calculated_at, variables[]. Each variable: key, status, score, calculated_at, title, rules[]. Rules: key, status, progress, progress_max, mode (OPPORTUNITY/COMPLETED), wordings{title, label}. New endpoint aggregates all old /health data. Auth: Bearer token ML. Rate limit: 1500 req/min per seller (429 on exceed).
